newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CyberCash cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CyberCash cut to hold.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Steven Birer has cut his rating on shares of CyberCash to hold from buy.
-- In a statement, Birer said CyberCash, a developer of software for Internet transactions, has met many milestones but the Internet buildout has been slower than expected.
-- The result is that CyberCash's "current customer base and environment does not support transaction volume to attain (Hambrecht & Quist's) $25 million revenue estimate for 1997," Birer said.
-- Birer added the company is about "12 months behind" Hambrecht & Quist's initial business model.
